title: An yarda da ƙa'idodi, bayanan batch da zama
course_title: Rijistar Kasuwanci & Yarda da Masu Kera Samfura: NAFDAC, SON da Safe Production

say: An yarda da ƙa'idodi, bayanan tsari, da kuma zama.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don tsari na uku na Rijistar Kasuwanci da Biyayya: girma, ganowa da sabuntawa.
Amincewa shine farkon, ba ƙarewa ba. Masu kera masaku, fata, kyandir, ko shimfidar duwatsu na iya buƙatar hukumar kula da daidaito ta Najeriya, SON, ba NAFDAC ba.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Amincewa shine farkon, ba ƙarewa ba
items: Wasu samfuran suna buƙatar SON, ba kawai NAFDAC ba

Kar a taɓa bari takardar shaida ta ƙare a hankali

say: Yayin da kuke girma, samfuran suna tafiya zuwa shaguna da gidajen da ba ku taɓa gani ba. Abun ganowa yana nufin cewa daga kowane fakiti ɗaya, zaku iya samun lokacin da aka yi, daga menene, ta wane, da kuma inda sauran wannan rukunin suka tafi.

say: Kuma yawancin masu yin da aka amince da su ba su yarda ba ba ta hanyar zamba ba, amma ta hanyar manta kwanan wata.

say: MANCAP shine tsarin ba da takaddun shaida na SON don samfuran da aka kera a cikin gida, sabanin ka'idojin masana'antu na Najeriya.
Misali, Bola a Abeokuta yana yin rini na adire, kuma wani sarkar dillali yana son tarawa. Ta ziyarci ofishin SON na jihar ta rubuta sunan jami’in da amsarsa.

panel.heading: Matakan MANCAP
items: Tuntuɓi ofishin jihar SON ko nema akan layi
Takaddun shaida na CAC, rahoton gwajin gwaji, biyan kuɗi
Aƙalla dubawa biyu kwata-kwata
Takaddun shaida da tambari tare da keɓaɓɓen lamba
Binciken kwata-kwata; sake tabbatarwa bayan shekaru uku

say: Ta gabatar da takardar shaidar ta CAC, rahoton gwaji daga dakin gwaje-gwajen da aka amince da SON ko IPAN, da kuma shaidar biyan kuɗi.

say: SON tana duba aƙalla sau biyu, kwata baya, kafin tabbatarwa. Don haka Bola yana tsammanin aƙalla watanni shida, kuma ya yi tambaya game da saurin gudu don ƙananan 'yan kasuwa.

say: Batch shine duk abin da aka yi daga haɗuwa ɗaya. Ba shi lambar kuma buga shi akan kowane fakitin. Misali, CC-260312-02 na nufin chin-chin, wanda aka yi a ranar 12 ga Maris 2026, tsari na biyu a wannan rana.

panel.heading: Batch lamba mai nufin wani abu

Rikodin rarrabawa: wanda ya sami wane tsari
Samfuran da aka riƙe sun wuce mafi kyau-da

say: Rikodin tsari ya lissafa kowane sinadari, mai siyar sa da kwanan watan ƙarewa, maɓalli da yanayin zafi, da wanda ya bincika tsari.

say: Rahoton rabon ta ya nuna fakiti 120: 40 zuwa wannan shagon, 50 zuwa babban kanti, sannan an sayar da 30 a WhatsApp ga kwastomomi 9.

say: Tana cirewa ta maye gurbin, ta tuntubi duk abokan cinikinta guda 9, ta koma wurin tsohon mai ba ta mai, ta kai rahoto ga NAFDAC. A cikin kwanaki biyu, an yi.
Idan korafi ya nuna rashin lafiya, wani abu na waje ko rashin lafiyan, dakatar da tallace-tallace a lokaci daya, ajiye shaida, karfafa mutum ya ga ma'aikacin lafiya, sannan a tuntubi NAFDAC.

panel.rule: Idan zai iya cutar da wani, dakatar da tallace-tallace da farko. Sannan bincike.

say: Horar da ma'aikata a matakai uku. Nuna: Cika rikodin tsari ɗaya da kanka yayin da suke kallo.

panel.heading: Koyar da bayanan: nunawa, yi, dubawa

cards.d: Cika rikodi guda ɗaya da kanka yayin da ma'aikaci ke kallo, yana bayanin dalilin da yasa kowane layi yake da mahimmanci.
Ma'aikacin ya cika rikodin na gaba yayin da kuke kallo, kuma kuna gyara a hankali a wurin.
Domin batches biyar na gaba, ma'aikacin ya cika shi kadai kuma ku duba ku sanya hannu akan kowanne.

say: Yi: suna cika na gaba yayin da kuke kallo kuma suna gyara a hankali.

say: Duba: na batches biyar, sun cika shi kadai kuma ku sanya hannu a kowane.
Bayyana dalilin. Ma'aikacin da ya san lambar batch yana adana kasuwancin a cikin tunowa ba zai tsallake ta a ranar Asabar mai cike da aiki ba.

say: Misali, Zainab ta karbi takardar shedar lissafinta a ranar 10 ga Fabrairu 2026. Zai kare bayan shekaru biyu, don haka ta sanya sanarwar sabuntawa don 10 ga Agusta 2027, watanni shida da wuri.

Ta tsara masu tunasarwar fumigation wata guda kafin kowace ranar ƙarshe, ta bincika gwaje-gwajen likita na kowane sabon ma'aikaci, da kuma sake duba fayil ɗin ta a ranar Litinin ta farko na kowane wata.
Kafin canza dabara, fakiti, da'awar lakabi, adireshin ko samfur, tambayi NAFDAC ko SON tukuna.

panel.heading: Kalandar yarda da ku
items: Takaddun shaida: tunatar da watanni 6 kafin
MANCAP: kowane kwata, kuma kafin ƙarewa
Fumigation: wata daya kafin lokacin
Gwaje-gwajen likita: lokacin daukar aiki da lokacin da ya dace
Bita na yarda: Litinin ta farko kowane wata

say: Don tunawa. Tambayi SON ko samfurinka yana buƙatar MANCAP. Saka lambar tsari akan kowane fakitin. Rubutun tsari da rarraba suna yin tunowa ƙanana da sauri.
Lokacin da aminci ke cikin shakka, dakatar da tallace-tallace da farko. Kuma sanya kowace ranar ƙarewa a cikin kalanda tare da tunasarwar farko.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Tambayi SON ko samfurinka yana buƙatar MANCAP
Lambobin lambar kwanan samfur akan kowane fakitin
Rubutun tsari da rarrabawa suna raguwa tunowa
Lokacin da aminci ke cikin shakka, dakatar da tallace-tallace da farko
Kowace ranar ƙarewa a cikin kalanda, da wuri

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Gina fakitin mai siyar ku, saita tsari, rarrabawa da bayanan ƙararraki don rukunin ku na gaba, kuma rubuta kalandar yarda da tsarin kwanaki 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gina fakitin mai siyar ku
Saita bayanan ganowa
Rubuta kalandarku da shirin kwanaki 90
